tools.name: get_current_rates
tools.description: Haven's current financing rates for each fixed term (3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y) and the monthly variable rate: financing rate, Haven fee, all-in rate, illustrative after-tax rate, as-of time and rate-lock eligibility.

tools.name: simulate_financing
tools.description: Calculate indicative financing costs for users considering borrowing against an investment portfolio. Accept portfolio value, requested financing amount, and selected term. When users have authorized access to connected financial information, relevant portfolio values and existing borrowing details

tools.name: compare_existing_debt
tools.description: Compares an existing loan (margin, SBLOC, HELOC, mortgage, personal loan, credit card) with Haven's all-in cost on every term: annual cost, savings, the lowest-cost option and the collateral Haven would need.

tools.name: create_onboarding_link
tools.description: Builds a link that opens Haven's financing simulator prefilled with a scenario, where the investor can review it and apply. Creates nothing and submits nothing; the link carries no personal data.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches Haven's reference documents (current rates, fees, collateral limits, rate locks, savings method, risks). Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full text of a document found with search.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "simulate_financing" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
